headline: Nigerian Naira Depreciates to N1,379.99/$ as Interbank FX Turnover Surges
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated to N1,379.99 per dollar in official trading despite interbank foreign exchange transaction volume rising above $500 million.
why: Nigeria's foreign exchange market faces volatility as monetary authorities work to clear currency backlog demand.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Strong foreign exchange demand pushed the naira lower against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Elevated dollar demand in the interbank market weighed on the local exchange rate.
